# Silent Power | Tao Te Ching

> Silent Power is an independent project by Yod Mem that makes the Tao Te Ching accessible without making it shallow: short illustrated books, free guides, music and videos in plain language. Books are sold and delivered as PDFs through Gumroad.

The books themselves are written in English. The site has translated pages (descriptions only) in Hebrew, Spanish, French, Italian, Hindi and Filipino. Hebrew has its own Hebrew-language books.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://silentpower.me/): overview of the project
- [Books & audio](https://silentpower.me/shop/): all titles
- [Free books](https://silentpower.me/free/): free short guides
- [About](https://silentpower.me/about/): who is behind the project
- [Journal](https://silentpower.me/journal/): short essays on the Tao Te Ching

## Books
- [The Taoist Secret to Becoming Unshakable](https://silentpower.me/shop/becoming-unshakable/): 84-page illustrated book, 16 chapters in 7 parts, $19. Method: See it. Name it. Let it be.
- [The Way of the Tao: Stop Pushing So Hard](https://silentpower.me/shop/stop-pushing/): free 21-page guide, about a 10-minute read.
